requirements.statement: A valid condition-passing LDM/STM emits an ascending multiword descriptor from the Addressing Mode 4 start through end address, carrying the ordered register list, word count, PC-load and base-writeback intents. A failed condition emits no memory sequence or writeback.

LDM/STM user-bank transfer and LDM exception return are reported as runtime UNPREDICTABLE in User or System mode. In an exception mode, S selects User-bank transfer unless LDM loads R15, in which case it requests SPSR restoration after the PC load.
